simple.meaning: עֹפֶל (ʻôphel) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a tumor ; also a mound , i.e. fortress.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 28:27. The surrounding context includes offering, city, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֹפֶל (H6076) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.

It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.
The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?”

Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.
When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.
For the palace will be forsaken.
You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion,

definitions.short: a tumor ; also a mound , i.e. fortress
definitions.full: H6076. ophel I. עֹ֫פֶל noun [masculine] mound, hill , only as acropolis; — ׳ע absolute 2Kin 5:24 +, construct Micah 4:8 ; — fortified mound or hill within city, or Jerusalem (compare Rob BR i. 267 Gu ZPV v (1882), 326 ) 4:8 ; Isa 32:14 ; south end of eastern hill Neh 3:26 ; 11:21 ; 2Chr 33:14 הָע ׳חוֺמַת Neh 3:27 ; 2Chr 27:3 (compare העפל חמת in קרחה MI 21, 22 ); of Samaria 2Kin 5:24 . II. [ עֹ֫פֶל ] noun masculine 1Sam 6:4 tumour ; — only plural Kt (בָּ)עֳפָלִים Deut 28:27 ; 1Sam 5:6 , 9 , 12 ; construct עָפְלֵי 6:4 ; suffix עָפְלֵיכֶם 6:5 ; Qr in all טְחֹרֵיכֶם טְחֹרֵי, (ב)טְחֹרִים, , see [ טְחוֺר ].
